title: Circuit output from combination roots
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb{N}$ with $k\le n$, let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{0,1\}$, and let $x\in\{0,1\}^n$. The Boolean disjunction of the values at all combination roots of the circuit constructed from $f$ and $k$, when evaluated on input $x$, equals $f(x)$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on $n$ bits
